adversarial_relevance: The shipped KPI asserts malformed-input fail-closed behaviour but every malformed record carries NO snapshot, so the fail-closed lexical ladder is only ever tested on the facts-absent branch. This audit shows the ladder is dead code when a snapshot is present, bounding the KPI's fail-closed claim to the facts-absent pathway and localising structural binding to the upstream host normaliser.
closes: First live-Rust exercise of the STRUCTURE x SNAPSHOT decision cell; the shipped fixture's 42 records leave the facts-present-x-invalid-structure and facts-present-x-mismatched-binding cells untested.

Establishes that design_gate_result's decision is authored entirely by the host-injected MoleculeFactsV1 snapshot; the candidate's own structure text and the snapshot's binding fields are not consulted.

Bounds the shipped KPI's malformed-fail-closed guarantee to the facts-absent pathway and localises structural binding to the upstream host normaliser (amphora-engine::normalize_molecule + molecule_facts).

Shows the MoleculeFactsV1 serde contract (u32, deny_unknown_fields, required fields) is the sole admission wall on the facts-present branch: 5 malformed snapshot classes fail closed, 1 well-typed forgery is accepted.
defect_disclosure: design_gate_result performs NO re-derivation of, and NO consistency check between, the injected snapshot and the candidate's own structure; the snapshot's canonical_structure_sha256 / canonical_isomeric_smiles binding fields are inert to the gate. Structural binding to THIS candidate is therefore a property of amphora-engine::normalize_molecule + amphora_rdkit_ffi::molecule_facts, not of the gate. This is a scope/provenance boundary finding, not a runtime crash; the gate's stated scope is structural-applicability-only over host-normalised facts.
does_not_close: Does not assert the finding is a runtime vulnerability: in the real engine pipeline the host normaliser is the party that emits snapshots, and it does so only for parseable single-component structures.
Does not exercise amphora-engine::normalize_molecule end-to-end (the snapshots here are injected at the capability boundary, exactly as the shipped KPI harness injects them).
Does not establish EHS, synthesis, qualification, procurement, regulatory, or product-performance authority.
Phase-1 still requires the pinned RDKit C++ boundary and host-normaliser binding wired and audited end-to-end, not the capability in isolation.
hypothesis: An independent re-implementation of the documented decision function reproduces the live runtime on all probes; forged positive snapshots on structurally inert or lexically invalid candidates SCORE/pass; the lexical structure ladder is inert whenever a well-typed snapshot is present; and the MoleculeFactsV1 serde contract is the sole admission wall on that branch.
non_circularity: Expected decisions are computed by an independent Python re-implementation of the documented decision function from probe metadata; observed decisions come from the live compiled Rust capability. The two are compared, not shared.
purpose: Exercise the STRUCTURE x SNAPSHOT decision cell the shipped 42-record Phase-0 fixture never covers, and establish against the live Rust design_gate_result that on the facts-present branch the gate decision is a pure function of the host-injected MoleculeFactsV1 (declared_role, oxirane>0, amine-H>0), consulting neither the candidate structure text nor the snapshot's structure-identity binding fields.
